summary: CervoMed Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market offering of 2,500,000 shares of common stock at $4.00/share via placement agent H.C. Wainwright. The offering is not a special situation; it is a routine equity raise. There is no minimum offering amount, no escrow, and proceeds will fund general corporate purposes. The stock trades on Nasdaq under CRVO. The filing does not involve a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or other transformative event. Risk-arb angle not applicable.
